entities.summary: The Shinano Railway Kita-Shinano Line  is a 37.3 km (23.2 mi) railway line operated by the third-sector railway operating company Shinano Railway in Nagano Prefecture, Japan, since 14 March 2015 following the opening of the Hokuriku Shinkansen extension north of Nagano and transfer of operations of the former Shinetsu Main Line from East Japan Railway Company. It connects Nagano Station in Nagano with Myōkō-Kōgen Station in Myōkō, Niigata.
